items.metric: Replies (week, three week run 14 to 7 to 5)
items.effect: Third straight weekly drop at a 13.51% reply rate caps sample approvals near 6 per week and thins creator posts three to four weeks out.
items.action: Lift DM volume from 37 to 90 per week with one 24 hour follow up to non-repliers.

items.effect: Videos rose 61.3% to 121 on 20% fewer creators, concentrating reach so the top two creators now hold 36.7% of affiliate GMV.
items.action: Win back the creators who posted last week but not this week with a bundle offer and a sample restock.

items.effect: Affiliate share fell from 77.8% to 64.3% while sylviaapproved dropped 65.9%, so ads now carry 75.6% of revenue at a 1.522 ROAS.
items.action: Hold affiliate at or above 70% of GMV by pairing the DM wave with post reminders to creators holding samples.

items.metric: LIVE GMV (47 streams, 58,631 views, three week zero run)
items.effect: Three straight weeks of zero LIVE GMV leaves 58,631 views and the 47 stream roster converting nothing.
items.action: Add a pinned bundle and a checkout call every 10 minutes, or move the airtime to affiliate posts by 2026-12-04.

items.metric: BFCM Seat Cushion GMV Max ROAS (target 1.7)
items.effect: The campaign spent 274.95 dollars for 5 orders at 54.99 cost per order, and with Elevate Seat Cushion the pair is 81.89 underwater before COGS.
items.action: Pause both seat cushion campaigns and move the budget to BFCM Screendoor at 2.061 ROAS.

items.metric: Sample requests expired (189 of 300, flag threshold 50%)
items.effect: Expiry rather than rejection (1.3%) is the binding constraint, with 53 fresh requests sitting in To Review and only 4 of 300 reaching Posted.
items.action: Clear the 53 To Review requests within 48 hours and set a 48 hour approval SLA with affiliate ops.
